name: Necromantic Rituals — Advanced — Chill of Oblivion

system.description: The subject lies naked on bare earth while a one-foot cube of ice melts on her chest over the course of a night (mortals take three levels of bashing damage). Once complete, for one week the subject converts fire/heat aggravated damage to lethal, may spend a Willpower Trait and win a Static Mental Challenge to extinguish nearby flames, and gains the Flaws Touch of Frost and Eerie Presence. Her aura appears as diablerie-tainted to the uninitiated, and malevolent spirits gain three Traits using powers against her.
